<body>
Here is the info on the tournament. We are one person short and could really use your help. Please try to let me know ASAP whether you can play so I can explore other options.

<quoted>
---------------------- Forwarded by Jay Nolan on 11/11/2024 10:32 AM ---------------------------

Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd.

From: Flag Football Challenge @ Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd.         21/10/2024 22:38

Sent by: KestrelAnnouncements@kestrelaero.co.uk
To: Flag Football Invite
cc: 
Subject: Kestrel/Strato Flag Football Invitation

Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd. and Strato Berry are proud to sponsor the 2nd Annual Strato-Kestrel Flag Football Challenge on Saturday, November 16. The purpose of this event is to raise money for both companies, and to enjoy the competitive spirit of one of the longest rivalries in aerospace manufacturing. This year's game marks the 107th meeting between Kestrel and Strato, and, with a little luck, the AeroTech South Title will be on the line!

Kestrel and Strato Berry are sponsoring the event, but we need your help as participants and fundraisers. Contributions raised will benefit the general employee scholarship fund for each company.

The details:
Date:    Saturday, November 16th

Time:    10:00 a.m. - approximately 4 p.m. (Warm up is at 9:30 am)

Location:   Falcon Fields (just off Avon Road, south of M32)

Food and Drinks:  Marshall’s BBQ (FREE - courtesy of Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd.)

Eligibility:   Full-time employees and/or their spouses
    (Players must have graduated from AeroTech University or Strato College)

Team Jerseys:  Provided by Kestrel and Strato Berry

Format:   7 players with at least 1 female player on the field at all times

Team Size: Recommend 8-10 players per team (no more than 10 per team). Contact the team captains to sign-up. (Sign-up now to ensure your place on a team)

Prizes:    Winning team receives 16 tickets to the Kestrel/Strato aerospace conference in Bristol on Friday, November 22. Winning team also owns the “AeroCup” trophy until next year!

Fundraising Goal: The committee has set a goal of raising £16,000 for each company. This will require a contribution of £2,000 per team, plus an equal amount from corporate matching funds.

Last year's event featured a last-minute comeback as Vector Dynamics defeated the Kestrel Falcons Team 1 for the championship and took home the tickets and the trophy. This year, expect the Falcons (and Strato Berry) to come in with revenge on their minds!

Thanks to the generous gift from the AeroTech Alumni, who redirected their donations to the Kestrel Foundation, we were able to permanently endow scholarships dedicated to the memory of the 12 engineers who died in last year's Falcon Plant incident. We believe this event is a great tradition for both companies, and we are pleased to be able to raise important funds for both institutions.

</quoted>
